title: [review] provisioning.py:351: Missing verification that ACK
description: The code extracts `received_pubkey` from the decrypted ACK (line 342), then passes it to the callback along with `iid` and `ygg_addr` derived from `session.provisioned_seed` (lines 354-360). However, there is no verification that `received_pubkey == Identity.from_seed(session.provisioned_seed).pubkey`. A malicious node could return an arbitrary pubkey in the ACK, causing the BR to record a pubkey that doesn't match the actual provisioned identity. The docstring explicitly states 'BR verifies ACK matches provisioned pubkey' but this verification is not implemented.
close_reason: Fixed: callback now passes derived pubkey (provisioned_id.pubkey) instead of received_pubkey from ACK. decrypt_ack() already validates the pubkey, but for defense-in-depth the callback should use the trusted derived value. Added SECURITY comment explaining the verification chain.
